episode_title: Writing the same book three times with Rebecca Murphey and Otto Hilska

real_qa.q: What is the AI paradox that Otto Hilska identifies in Build third edition?
real_qa.r: Individual developers 10x and the organization gets 10%. Organizations are figuring out where this comes from, what the bottlenecks are. The exciting part is that the ceiling has moved up and everyone knows there is a productivity gain somewhere, but it hasn't fully unlocked yet.

real_qa.q: How does Build third edition address code review as a bottleneck in AI-driven development?
real_qa.r: Rebecca Murphey identifies code review as a really pressing problem and challenge at Honeycomb. A survey using Swarmia found that code review was identified as the number one bottleneck in free form text responses, with people choosing it over other possible answers.
real_qa.requete: Build third edition code review bottleneck

real_qa.q: What is the new way of working described in Build for engineering teams using AI?
real_qa.r: A developer's job is to build the system that builds the product, not building the product directly. This means building automations, custom review agents, and agents that work completely automatically like investigating production exceptions or slow queries proactively, so teams avoid coordination challenges.
real_qa.requete: Build new way of working build system that builds product

real_qa.q: How long did it take Swarmia to build an integration using AI agents according to Build?
real_qa.r: Swarmia shipped its first integration using AI agents in two days. Integrations used to take two months to build, which made them difficult prioritization decisions.
real_qa.requete: Swarmia AI agents integration two days

real_qa.q: What fundamental concepts remain unchanged despite AI adoption according to Rebecca Murphey in Build?
real_qa.r: The theory of constraints is still real and organizational effectiveness depends on empowered teams, rapid feedback, and outcomes over output. AI changes the shape of problems but not the fundamental nature of those problems.
real_qa.requete: Build theory of constraints fundamental unchanged AI
